about: Which logo a model gets. Matched on the model id (the last path segment of a ref), never on the host: Claude through Bedrock is still Claude. First family that matches wins. A model whose family is unknown gets the served-by mark when the host is listed under 'served', else the neutral generic mark. Never the φ.

families.name: Z.ai
families.note: GLM is Zhipu's; Z.ai is Zhipu's mark since 2025, and its dot-field logo does not survive 14px

brand.about: Brand colour is drawn only in the model selection menu and its chip preview. A colour fill under 3:1 against the menu row it sits on keeps its hue and moves in OKLab lightness until it reaches 3:1, per scheme, through light-dark(); the shipped value stays as the fill attribute.
